result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major content/data issue and one minor truncation issue.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery price. NaN (Not a Number) is a JavaScript error that has leaked into the UI, indicating a failed numeric computation for the delivery fee.
issues.suggestion: Fix the delivery fee calculation logic to handle missing or null values gracefully. Display a fallback such as '€0.00', 'Free', or 'N/A' instead of allowing NaN to render in the UI.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll section is truncated without an ellipsis or proper overflow handling, cutting off the full name abruptly.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text truncation with ellipsis (text-overflow: ellipsis) or increase the card width to accommodate longer restaurant names.
